name: Amakawa Kanon
source:
An older sister type who runs the guesthouse in place of her hospitalized grandfather. Cheerful and playful, she thinks she's just fooling around, but her sex appeal is unintentionally lethal.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HP/enjoy/character111.html]official website[/url]]
